title: Founder Runtime Store Live Admission Execution Contract
goal: Define the store live admission execution contract and safety boundary before any governed DB-backed or live execution behavior is added.
safetyRules: P132.1 is contract/checker/docs/status only.

Do not create DB schemas, run migrations, read or write DB/runtime records, persist requests, execute CRUD, capture approvals, accept handoff, grant authority, unlock execution, call providers/models, dispatch agents, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.

Do not modify project-owned files.
